nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances for each address. Written in _transferStandard and _takeTeam after external calls, making it a reentrancy-sensitive state variable.
ERC20 allowance mapping (owner => spender => amount) mutated by _approve.
Blacklist mapping of addresses blocked from transferring, controlled by setBots/delBot.
Per-address cooldown timestamp map; set from block.timestamp in _transfer (timestamp dependency).
Total reflection supply, reduced by _reflectFee; divisor source for _getRate.
Buy/sell tax fee numerator (2 or 8) selected inside _transfer.
Team fee numerator (8 or 10) selected inside _transfer.
Fee receiver wallet 1 and authorization principal for manualswap/manualsend.
Fee receiver wallet 2 receiving half of accumulated ETH.
Uniswap V2 router interface used for swaps and liquidity; set in openTrading.
Automatically created token/WETH pair address used in transfer gating logic.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by lockTheSwap and used to gate swap logic in _transfer.
Flag enabling automatic contract-token swapping, activated in openTrading.
Flag enabling per-address cooldown checks in _transfer.
Maximum transfer amount enforced by the cooldown branch in _transfer.
Contract owner address checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Untrusted caller-controlled address used for authorization, ownership checks and token movement.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for cooldown logic and swap/liquidity deadlines.
Public ERC20 transfer forwarding caller and inputs into _transfer.
Core transfer routine: applies fees, bot/cooldown checks and triggers swapTokensForEth/sendETHToFee before balances are updated.
Swaps accumulated contract tokens for ETH through the router; guarded by lockTheSwap and performs an external call.
Distributes contract ETH balance equally to two fee wallets via low-level transfer calls.
Only-owner setup that configures the router/pair and adds initial liquidity with block.timestamp deadline.
Only-owner loop that blacklists an arbitrary array of addresses.
Privileged manual trigger of swapTokensForEth, authorized only for _feeAddrWallet1.
Privileged manual trigger of sendETHToFee, authorized only for _feeAddrWallet1.
Internal transfer engine updating _rOwned balances and invoking team/fee accounting.
Credits team fee reflections to the contract's own _rOwned balance.
Reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal (arithmetic-sensitive state updates).
Converts reflection amounts to token amounts using _getRate.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens then decrements allowance via _approve.
Internal allowance setter writing to _allowances.
Only-owner function removing an address from the bots blacklist.
External router call performing the token->ETH swap; executed while owner/contract state is still mutable (reentrancy vector).
Native ETH push to external fee wallets using transfer; external call consuming gas and reverting on failure.
External payable liquidity provision call sending contract ETH balance to the router/pair.
Sender address parameter of _transfer.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer.
Transfer amount parameter of _transfer.
Contract token balance captured in _transfer before swapping.
Swap path array constructed in swapTokensForEth.
Array of addresses passed to setBots.
Loop counter i in setBots.
Token amount parameter of swapTokensForEth.
Token amount parameter of _transferStandard / _getValues.
Reflection fee parameter of _reflectFee.
Amount parameter of sendETHToFee.

edges.reason: transfer() is invoked by msg.sender and moves tokens on the caller's behalf.
transfer delegates the state mutation to _transfer.
msg.sender is used as the _msgSender() sender argument inside _transfer.
Sender parameter feeds the from address checks and balance updates.
Recipient parameter feeds the to address checks and balance updates.
Amount parameter drives fee computation and requires amount > 0.
transferFrom calls _transfer before consuming the allowance.
transferFrom flow reaches _transfer via the public entrypoint chain.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth (external router call) before token balances are updated, exposing a reentrancy window.
_transfer pushes ETH to fee wallets via sendETHToFee after the swap and before balance settlement.
_transfer reads the bots blacklist to block blacklisted senders/recipients.
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping using block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
_transfer enforces the amount <= _maxTxAmount limit.
_transfer checks the inSwap reentrancy guard flag.
_transfer only swaps when swapEnabled is true.
_transfer gates limit enforcement behind the owner-controlled cooldownEnabled flag.
_transfer computes contractTokenBalance from balanceOf(address(this)).
contractTokenBalance is passed as the tokenAmount to swapTokensForEth.
_transfer finalizes accounting through _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard.
_transferStandard decrements/increments _rOwned balances.
_transferStandard routes team fee to _takeTeam.
_transferStandard routes reflection fee to _reflectFee.
_takeTeam credits the contract _rOwned balance with the team reflections.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal, an arithmetic-sensitive supply update.
tAmount parameter is consumed by _getValues inside _transferStandard.
rFee parameter is subtracted from _rTotal inside _reflectFee.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call that can reenter the token contract.
Balance state in _rOwned is settled only after the external swap returns, enabling reentrant state reads/writes.
tokenAmount parameter flows into the router swap amountIn.
path array is built and supplied to the router swap call.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve before swapping.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
_approve stores amount for owner/spender pairs (via approve/transferFrom paths).
sendETHToFee performs external ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
sendETHToFee sends half the ETH to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee sends half the ETH to _feeAddrWallet2.
amount parameter is divided by two inside sendETHToFee.
manualswap triggers swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualswap authorization depends on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend triggers sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
manualsend authorization depends on _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1.
msg.sender is compared against the privileged fee wallet before swapping.
msg.sender is compared against the privileged fee wallet before sending ETH.
block.timestamp is written into the cooldown mapping, giving miner-influenced transfer gating.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
openTrading uses block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
onlyOwner restricts openTrading to the owner address.
openTrading performs the external addLiquidityETH call.
openTrading assigns the router address to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading creates and stores the pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
onlyOwner restricts setBots to the owner address.
setBots marks addresses as bots in the blacklist mapping.
bots_ array parameter supplies the addresses to blacklist.
loop index i iterates over the supplied bots_ array.
onlyOwner restricts delBot to the owner address.
delBot clears the bots flag for the given address.
tokenFromReflection reads _rOwned to compute token balances.
_rOwned values are converted through tokenFromReflection in balanceOf.
_rTotal bounds the rAmount and feeds _getRate division in tokenFromReflection.
_feeAddr1 tax numerator influences fee amounts ultimately reflected around _reflectFee.
_feeAddr2 team numerator influences team fee amounts reflected around _reflectFee.

normalization_plan.reason: from address parameter only exists to drive _transfer, so it collapses into that core function node.
to address parameter only exists to drive _transfer, so it collapses into that core function node.
amount parameter is consumed solely by _transfer accounting and should merge into _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is computed for and passed directly into swapTokensForEth, so it merges into that core function.
path array is constructed solely for the router swap inside swapTokensForEth.
bots_ array parameter only feeds the setBots blacklist loop.
loop index i exists only within setBots and should merge into that core function.
tokenAmount parameter flows directly into the router swap amount inside swapTokensForEth.
tAmount parameter is consumed only by _transferStandard/_getValues accounting.
rFee parameter is subtracted from _rTotal exclusively inside _reflectFee.
amount parameter is divided between the two fee wallets only inside sendETHToFee.
